names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 9 noiembrie, «Cuviosul Neofit Dohiaritul»; the bare personal name, without the epithet.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 9 Νοεμβρίου, «Όσιοι Ευθύμιος και Νεόφυτος κτήτορες της Μονής Δοχειαρίου Αγίου Όρους», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 9. новембар ст. ст., „Преп. Јевтимије Дохијарски и ученик му Неофит.“ — the heading gives him nothing but the bare forename after «и ученик му», and his disciple; the monastery in this folder’s English name is not in the heading and was not put into the form. A bare forename is a fold and the brief says so; what this one folds with is keyed in `scripts/corpus-gate.mjs` in the same commit if it folds with anything.

source.text: doxologia.ro, calendarul pentru 9 noiembrie — «Cuviosul Neofit Dohiaritul»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 9ης Νοεμβρίου — «Όσιοι Ευθύμιος και Νεόφυτος κτήτορες της Μονής Δοχειαρίου Αγίου Όρους»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 9 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder already keeps, and the entry is the same man and the same house, with Euthymius his uncle beside him. The page puts him in the reigns of Nikephoros Phokas and John Tzimiskes, 963 to 976, and gives no year of his own; the reigns are recorded as a floruit. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence, and it prints no hymn.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 22.11.2025 (9. новембар ст. ст.) — „Преп. Јевтимије Дохијарски и ученик му Неофит.“

attestations.note: The day’s fourth entry, in which the heading names him as the disciple of the man it heads. `dates` GAINS A DEATH it did not have: the folder held a floruit of 963–976 off saint.gr and no death, and the entry says «Упокојио се почетком XI столећа», he reposed at the beginning of the eleventh century, which is recorded as 1001–1033 in the form this corpus already uses for an early century. The two readings do not contradict one another. The entry also makes the tie to his teacher a FAMILY one — «Његов синовац Неофит», his nephew — where the folders had only abbot and founder, and says both men were Serbs by origin.

floruit.note: saint.gr: «ήταν γιος δούκα στα χρόνια των βασιλέων Νικηφόρου Φωκά και Ιωάννου Τσιμισκή» — the son of a duke in the years of the emperors Nicephorus Phocas and John Tzimiskes, whose reigns are the interval. Carried forward unchanged from the reading that made this folder; the death beside it is a separate reading and the two do not contradict each other.

death.note: The Охридски пролог for 9. новембар ст. ст.: «Упокојио се почетком XI столећа» — he reposed at the beginning of the eleventh century. The only reading of his death any source read gives; neither doxologia.ro nor saint.gr gave this folder one, and the bounds are this corpus’s own for an early century.
